items.title: ChatGPT Images 2.5 vs Nano Banana 2: Which One is Better?
items.snippet: OpenAI's new image model promises sharper detail and more precise editing. We ran it against Google's Nano Banana 2 across six categories to see how it compares.

items.title: Bitcoin activity, passports exposed after Revolut falls for fake government request
items.snippet: Passports, selfies and home addresses were also handed over after the digital bank treated a fraudulent request as legitimate, but no customer funds were lost.
